title: Staging observability · GreptimeDB qualification
description: Upstream GreptimeDB staging qualification toward a possible future Pulse fork. No fork or production cutover exists. All queries use the read-only dashboard identity.

panels.title: Scrape target health
panels.description: Actual ingested up series. No series is not a successful health check.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, body, severity_text AS level, trace_id, span_id, json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.name"]') AS service_name FROM opentelemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent spans
panels.description: Copy a trace_id into the Trace ID field to inspect its waterfall below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp, trace_id, span_id, service_name, span_name, duration_nano / 1000000.0 AS duration_ms, span_status_code FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT timestamp, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, span_name, duration_nano, span_status_code FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND trace_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(${trace_id:sqlstring}, ''), (SELECT trace_id FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1000
